description: RDS instance deletion protection is disabled
rationale: The RDS DB instance reports DeletionProtection=false. Accidental or unauthorized deletion can cause data loss; snapshots, backup retention and IAM controls must be assessed separately. This observation does not establish protection for clusters or replicas outside the collected instance scope.
remediation: Review the DB instance lifecycle and enable DeletionProtection where applicable. Confirm production-change approvals, snapshots and backup/restore testing independently.
